mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WEB_NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'N'

SELECT NOTICE_NO , USER_NAME , NOTICE_TITLE , CREATE_DATE , COUNT FROM WEB_NOTICE notice JOIN WEB_MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE notice.STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{noticeLimit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT NOTICE_NO , USER_NAME , NOTICE_TITLE , NOTICE_CONTENT , CREATE_DATE , COUNT FROM WEB_NOTICE JOIN WEB_MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE WEB_NOTICE.STATUS = 'N' AND NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
